name: Second Skin

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Ravenloft Dark Gift. Alter Self, free once per Long Rest and without Concentration; a catalyst can force the change on you.

benefits.name: Second Shape
benefits.summary: Alter Self always prepared; once per Long Rest cast it without a slot or Concentration.
benefits.text: You always have Alter Self prepared. Once per Long Rest you can cast it without a spell slot or Material components, and that casting doesn't require Concentration. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you take the gift).

drawback.name: Drawback
drawback.summary: A catalyst you choose (a moon phase, a sound, a smell) forces the change; if your free casting is spent, you are Stunned until the start of your next turn instead.
drawback.text: Choose a catalyst: a phase of the moon, a particular sound or a smell. When you meet it, you cast Alter Self using your free casting; if you've already used it since your last Long Rest, the change wracks you instead and you have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn.
